name: Twitch Social Networks Dataset
description: The Twitch Social Networks dataset contains user-user friendship and follower networks of gamers on Twitch across six distinct language subgraphs (DE, EN, ES, FR, PT, RU). Nodes represent Twitch users and links represent mutual follower relationships, with node features capturing gameplay preferences, account age, and stream flags for binary classification of mature content.
